description: Unified locked feature contract for IoT Device Security Monitoring and Threat Detection Platform. All datasets, Zeek flow parsers, ML training, live inference, DPI escalation, and retraining must follow this schema without modification unless roadmap version changes officially.

features.name: packet_count
features.description: Total packets observed in the flow

features.name: byte_count
features.description: Total bytes transferred in the flow

features.name: conn_state
features.description: Connection state such as S0, SF, REJ

features.name: dns_query_count
features.description: Number of DNS queries observed for the flow/session

features.name: label
features.description: Ground truth or predicted label such as benign, attack, anomaly

notes: This file is the single source of truth for feature alignment.
No service is allowed to invent new training features without updating roadmap version officially.
All datasets must be transformed into this exact schema before training.
All live Zeek flow outputs must be transformed into this exact schema before inference.
